verdict.rationale: Published compute specs are a fair question for a GPU, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no tensor TFLOPS or AI TOPS figures, let alone ones stating precision (FP4/FP8/FP16) or sparsity. The NVIDIA pages cited cover only DLSS, gaming and creator marketing plus CUDA tooling. Community items give memory bandwidth (896 GB/s) and CUDA core count, but these are adjacent specs, not tensor throughput.
